notes.title: Update 7. Game Play, System, and Item
notes.notes:
Hey Guys,
Here we're back with the latest update 7 again!
See below and let us know if you've got something to share with us :)

1. Game Play
1) Added a new map for 8 PVP
       Harbor (for death match and team death match mode)
https://i.imgur.com/piKdesS.jpg?1

2) Added critical shot
       Critical shot is to increase enemy's incoming damage by different body part
       When headshot, the probability of critical shot is 70%
       When body shot (elsewhere than head), the probability of critical shot is 30%
https://i.imgur.com/zrdvz40.jpg?1

3) Added weapon attribute for multiple kinds of weapons
       Decreased the probability of critical shot when grabbing weapons
       Increased the probability of critical shot when attacking others
       Decreased the incoming damage when grabbing weapons
       Increased the transport speed
       Decreased the transport speed of other enemies
       Added reloading and firing golden bullet

2. System
1) Added an user map editor (Download at here )
https://i.imgur.com/x9LuZjO.jpg
       Customize map by creating and/or changing mode by user's preference
       Basic game mode plus sample mode (e.g. basketball, soccer, jumping the obstacle, defense mode)
https://i.imgur.com/K1kaC4x.jpg?1
       Supported by SFIW Mod Making Tool at STEAM Workshop
       Users can upload a customized mode on STEAM Workshop
       Users can browse and download customized map or mode created by other users
       Users can create or enter game

3. Item
1) Added new special item - Golden Armor (For Ranking Match Only)
       Earn ranking point's extra buff
       Only 1 golden armor available per play
       Automatically obtained and worn when get close to an icon
       Name of player armed with golden armor will flicker in gold
https://i.imgur.com/oWXyyTN.gifhttps://i.imgur.com/jZIPJHG.gif
https://i.imgur.com/ykHRTME.jpg?1
https://i.imgur.com/aUzNyi7.jpg?1

notes.title: Update 5. Game Play, System, Item, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey guys!
Here we’re back with the latest update 5.
Let’s see what we’ve got and hope you enjoy our new addition.

 
1. Game Play
1) Added a function of movement speed per weapon
 Speed can be adjusted by type of weapon (main, sub, proximity, grenade, etc.)

2) Added a function of voting system in map
 Map can be voted and selected on the ballot after game play

3) Added a function of AI cover up
 AI can take covers in the battle

4) Added a function of weapon drop-off
 Defeated player drops his weapon when killed

5) Added a function of weapon pick-up
 Player can pick up the weapons being dropped by the defeated or placed in the lobby  
 Player can activate this pick up function by placing a hand on dropped gun and pressing a grip button.
https://i.imgur.com/mekoCCt.gif

6) Renewed character skill
 Changed Delta Force effect of "Respond Time Reduction" to "Enemy Detection Sensor"
 Player can activate the detecting sensor by placing a secondary hand on helmet and pressing a grip button (toggle)
https://i.imgur.com/S3loFdq.gif



2.  System
1) Restored an advanced lobby UI
https://i.imgur.com/xCXb0wz.gif
 Improved a target controller placement and indoor shooting range function
 Shooting range device and target board can be operated by a secondary hand 
 Added an armory and NEXT UPDATE store display panel
 Displayed weapon can be picked up by placing a primary hand on armory and grabbing with a grip button
 Added a zone of the NEXT UPDATE weapon customization
https://i.imgur.com/7WFvyjX.gif
 Reformed main UI/UX and changed a compilation plan
 Added custom game UI

2) Added a playground
 Pre-access to the playground (custom mode)
https://i.imgur.com/WJJFrHQ.gif
https://i.imgur.com/LGRc5Fm.gif
https://i.imgur.com/hBcjSS6.gif

3) Added an announcement API
 Access to lobby (in-game) announcement 



3. Item
1) Upgrade an overall quality and interior structure of gun
 Pistol) Desert Eagle / Veretta M9 / G18C
 AR) M4A1 / AK47 / F1 / Mk.18 Mod.1 
 SR) AWM
 SMG) MP5 / P90 / AMP45
 Shotgun) M590

2) Added new character
 Chinese SLCU (Snow Leopard Commando Unit; 雪豹突击队)
https://i.imgur.com/cQsH7sM.jpg



4. Bugs Fixed
 Fixed an issue where gun control was unavailable within special option environment
 Fixed an issue where bullet was not able to break through wire-entanglements of certain maps
 3) Fixed an issue where SWAT character was lack of shadow effect
 4) Fixed an issue where characters' shadow effect was unavailable in Cost Guard map
 5) Fixed an issue where voice chat was unavailable



Thank so much for your support!
Keep us posted of your thoughts if any and many thanks in advance. 

Cheers 😊

notes.title: Update 3. Here is a Huge Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all!
Here is an official 3rd update as I mentioned last week!

1. Game Play 
1) Added a function of manual weapon control 
  - Overall manual weapon control
  - Added functions like magazine assembly & disassembly, bolt or slide moving back and forward, etc. 
  - Added technical reload function and bolt action 
   (We will upload detailed guideline of manual weapon control) 
2) Added an option of manual/auto weapon control 
  - Provided an option to choose manual or auto weapon control 
3) Detailed segmentation modeling of weapon control 
  - Detailed modeling of each weapon’s chamber and bolt
  - Added modeling of pistol, assault rifle, sniper rifle, and shotgun ammunition
  - Added modeling of bullets by gun and full and empty magazines
4) Improved a feedback effect of manual/auto control 
  - Added a controller vibration effect and fine-tuning 
5) Changed basic balance of firearms and improved some balances of firearms
  - Some balance improvements due to gun control changes
6) Improved control function regarding gun control 
  - Fire adjustment of control functions related to manual/auto operation
7) Improved footprint sounds
  - Improved various movement sounds of characters
8) Gun fire and reload sound improvements
  - Adjusted complex shooting sound and gun sound subdivision

2. System
1) Added firearm manual control system
  - Provided an option to select manual or auto gun control 
2) Provided and changed some optional functions 
  - Added and improved optional functions for control 
3) Added technical gunplay
  - Added manual control and technical gunplay system
4) Flow change of initial access and progress of game 
  - Improved and added a function of initial access option selection
5) Added a guide panel for adding a controller
  - Added WMR-Odyssey guide panel
6) Improved a function of adding AI
  - Fixed AI related issues and provided additional functions
7) Improved a tutorial function
  - Improved tutorial manipulation details
8) Applied game localization
  - Additional features and updates on localization of international languages

3. Bugs Fixed
1) Fixed an issue where secondary hand grip was released due to recoil 
2) Fixed an issue where location recognition was not possible when aiming WMR guns
3) Fixed an AI's patrol issue on some map areas 
4) Fixed an issue where AI route is abnormal in narrow passage

This is a pretty huge update. I hope you guys enjoy it!
Cheers,

notes.title: Another update will be on the next week!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

There will be another update on the next week!
The two major elements of the update will be:

2) Windows Mixed Reality Support without SteamVR 

I will post more specific information for this upcoming update soon!
Please keep your eye on our hard work!
Cheers,

notes.title: Update 2. Game Play, System, New Weapons, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, 

We have been working hard on fixing bugs and improving performance. 
Please check the below updated information. We hope this update will have a more stable experience of gameplay!

1) Game Play

 Added a setting function of initial access option
    We added UI for optional function selection and flow for initial game access
 Added camera rotation function of Vive Controller
    Added a function of basic camera rotation of Vive Controller. 
    Relevant information is applied in the lobby guide panel.
 Improved weapon use feedback
    Adjusted weapon use vibration feedback sink and strength
 Improved visibility of scoreboard
    Added a function to check in-game player status and session creator
 Improved function and visibility for scope
    Added option to use gun scope
    Improved gun scope visibility and bug fixes
 Recoil improvement
    Added new firearm feedback function (recoil)
 Gun balance adjustment
    Improved overall gun balance and enhanced inventory numbers


2) System

 Added wrist watch system 
    Added wrist watch system to check gameplay time and character status
 Added UI pop-up message for notification of connection failure
 Added two-hand grip mode option (option provided) 
 Added character and weapon preset function
 Added sniper mode option (option provided) 
 Improved AI function
    Added algorithm related to throwing weapons
    Added sprint function
    Added the ability to use secondary weapons
 Changed weapon replacement function
    Added panel function of in-game weapon replacement


3) New Main Weapons Added

 AMP45 - SMG
 Mk.18 Mod.1 - AR
 F1 - AR

 * If you would like to know detailed stats and images of new weapons, please check the artwork page!

4) Bug Fixes

 Fixed scope mesh abnormal output issue
    We fixed an issue that made it difficult to properly check the scope on the HMD during shooting
 Fixed AI targeting algorithm issue
    Fixed an issue where AI first targeted of long distant targets
 Fixed AI hand animation issue
    Fixed an issue where animations were displayed abnormally when AI used secondary weapons
 Fixed an abnormal issue of fire recoil controller
    Fixed an issue that gun recoil is abnormal when both controllers are in different directions
 Fixed cartridge reload issue 
    Fixed an issue where the cartridge reload (shotgun) function did not work 
 Fixed controller feedback frequency issue
    Fixed an issue where recoil was higher than conventional recoil due to fire vibration frequency 
 Fixed AK47 firearm support hand issue
    Fixed an issue where the right hand support hand was out of position



Thank you so much for all your comments and support!
We will keep listening what you say and work hard on improving our game more!

Cheers,

notes.title: The Build Update Required
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

SPECIAL FORCE VR: INFINITY WAR supports the matchmaking between
the same version of builds because of the stability of gameplay.

Users who do not update will not have any issues on a single play, 
but there may have difficulty in matchmaking.

We recommend to update the build!

Thank you for your understanding and support. 
Cheers,

notes.title: Update 1. Adjustment and Function Added
notes.notes:
Hello Guys!

This is a first official update after receiving critical issues and bugs reported from players. We fixed the below issues and added some functions. 

 Function Added 
1) Two hands grip of a firearm with a grip button 
2) Available to run even while holding a firearm with two hands as long as not firing an aimed shot
3) Available to filter by ping condition in matchmaking
4) Two hands grip of a pistol 
5) Continuous shooting of pistol by pressing a trigger button 
6) Support for bHaptics haptic suit

 Adjustment 
1) Adjusted footstep sound
2) Enhanced the shot effect
3) Turn off the floating timers in HUD
4) Changed the magazine range for reloading
5) Changed the configuration of option UI 

We always appreciate for all your positive and negative comments. 
Please play the game and keep posting your valuable comments and reviews. We will keep looking into it and If there is an issue, 
we will resolve it promptly and accurately. 

Thank you again!
Cheers,
